observations.contract: Direct-study gate with an invalid NaN target
observations.trace: BestiaryHours exposes public f32 fields and direct_mut. For the source-level hypothetical wildmen=NaN, human=1000 and all other fields zero, direct_fields_valid(5000) rejects the target field. In effective(Wildmen), the target comparison NaN <= 0 is false, so the intended direct-study early return is bypassed. The NaN contribution itself is normalized to zero, while the human contribution has coefficient0.65; the selected formula therefore produces about650. The already recovered Adler338 discussion identified this NaN gate and its rejecting predicate; this exact example and selected current caller tracing are newly assessed.
observations.remaining: This is source and pinned floating-point semantics reasoning only: no values, operation, product, test, decoder or training session ran. Simulation profile ingestion explicitly calls direct_fields_valid and rejects invalid hours; whether another ordinary persisted, decoded or trained path can retain this state remains open. No conclusion is drawn that gameplay currently admits it. Correlation is deliberately one-pass; the source test expects combined effective hours can reach or exceed5000, so no new global effective-hour clamp is inferred.

observations.contract: Category text, typed owner and build catalog
observations.trace: The build script reads organization content and passes documents to organization_catalog_validation::validate_documents before embedding. Its distinct BESTIARY string list currently matches the13 BestiaryCategory id strings, and it rejects unknown bestiary curriculum category and requirement leaf text. The public TrainingTarget::Bestiary retains category as String; apply_curriculum_training converts through BestiaryCategory::from_id and silently skips an unrecognized value. Credential curriculum forwards a requirement leaf into that target, while typed BookTarget and UI paths use BestiaryCategory directly. The pinned catalog source includes spirit and beast examples; this is source inspection, not proof a build or gameplay path ran.
observations.remaining: No currently mismatched category in the two inspected lists is claimed. The catalog validates authored paths but public direct constructors and all other producers require separate discovery. Determine whether duplicated list ownership and retained String should be unified at the appropriate boundary without changing intentionally stable external IDs. No exact alias, runtime failure or complete producer set is established.
